newsitem.title: UK: Vickers Q1 Rolls-Royce car sales up 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vickers Q1 Rolls-Royce car sales up 13 pct.

text.p: British vehicle-maker Vickers Plc said on Wednesday that worldwide sales of Rolls-Royce cars rose 13 percent to 446 in the first quarter.
The company said UK sales were the main driver of the increase, with sales of Rolls-Royce and Bentley cars surging 49 percent to 236 versus the year-ago period.
Sales in the Americas firmed 2.0 percent, while sales in Japan rose 7.0 percent, and sales in continental Europe fell 17 percent.
